# `aria_nbv` API Reference

This section is generated from Google-style docstrings in `aria_nbv/aria_nbv/`.
The published GitHub Pages build refreshes these pages via `quartodoc` in
`.github/workflows/quarto-publish.yml`.

This is the public package-contract surface. The generated reference follows
the importable `aria_nbv` package topology while excluding app, UI, data-cache,
and experimental roots that are not stable package documentation surfaces.

Package docstrings own conceptual contracts, equations, shapes, references, and
actor/oracle boundaries because they remain closest to the implementation. Use
the nested module pages for ASE/EFM snippets, strict VIN offline stores, target
selection, rollouts, rendering, RRI metrics, training entrypoints, and VIN
one-step scoring internals.
